definitions.floor: Both synthetic regions have a fixed published floor of -50 CNY/MWh; equality defines floor events.
definitions.channel: One distinct outward channel per region, positive export, no shared-channel double counting. Event utilization is capacity-time weighted.
definitions.renewable: Synthetic verified available generation and actual generation; official fixture definition is actual energy / available energy. This is a supplied fixture convention, not a universal enterprise statistic.
definitions.missing: No missing rows in complete case. Missing-availability variant must not make a curtailment claim.

delivery: report with current references and limitations
variants: revise one input and invalidate descendants

demo2.prerequisite: Registered Authority supplies a revision-pinned model, consistent state and supported optimization plus independent AC validation.
assertions: all required checks refer to the selected candidate
nonconvergence is not a valid zero-violation result
demo2.unsupported_policy: Disable unsupported capability; do not substitute generic code or synthetic evidence.
